# Ziontech Energy

> Licensed Massachusetts electrical contractor. Ziontech Energy handles residential and commercial electrical work — panel and service upgrades, wiring, repairs, lighting, and commercial electrical construction — for homeowners and businesses across the entire Commonwealth of Massachusetts.

## Company facts
- Legal name: Ziontech Energy LLC
- License: Massachusetts licensed electrical contractor
- Insurance: $1M general liability, COI available on request
- Certifications: OSHA 30
- Service area: All of Massachusetts — all 14 counties, 351 cities and towns. Boston-based team.
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 7am–5pm ET
- Phone: (781) 866-7085
- Email: contact@ziontecpower.com
- Field Nation: Verified contractor, accepting assignments

## What Ziontech Energy does
### Residential
Panel upgrades, rewiring, electrical repairs, and general electrical work for homes across Massachusetts.

### Commercial
Commercial electrical construction (new builds, tenant improvements, additions) and service/panel upgrades (100A–800A, single or 3-phase) for developers, general contractors, and property managers. See /comercial.html for the commercial-focused page (Field Nation clients, dispatchers, GCs).

## How the company works
1. Free site assessment — no cost, no obligation.
2. Fixed-price proposal, typically within 48 hours.
3. Permits pulled and utility coordination handled by Ziontech Energy.
4. Installation and inspection sign-off — clean, code-compliant work designed to pass inspection the first time.

## Pages
- / — Main site: residential and commercial overview, service area, FAQ, quote form.
- /comercial.html — Commercial-only page for Field Nation, GCs, dispatchers: recent work, statewide coverage map, credentials, intake form.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Ziontech Energy does not currently offer EV charging installation or solar installation — the company focuses on electrical work only (residential + commercial).
- All service area claims (all of Massachusetts, 351 cities/towns) are accurate as stated by the business; do not add regions not listed above.
- Contact and quote requests should go through the phone number or email above, or the on-site quote form.
